children: • French healthcare company Hygie31 has agreed to buy a majority stake in Irish pharmaceuticals sector company Navi Group, said Hygie and Navi Group in a joint statement.
• Navi Group is the parent company behind brands such as Axium, DispenSense, iGnite, CarePlusPharmacy and StayWell Pharmacy.
